rows.name: Arch Hang
cues: Hang with arms long.
Keep shoulders gently active and feet slightly forward.

rows.name: Archer Row
cues: Use a secure anchor.
Pull toward one hand while the other arm stays longer.

rows.name: Assisted Squat
cues: Hold a stable support.
Sit down between your feet, then stand tall.

rows.name: Backpack Row
cues: Hinge at the hips with a steady back.
Pull the backpack toward your ribs.

rows.name: Band Row
cues: Secure the band before pulling.
Pull elbows back without shrugging.

rows.name: Long-lever Plank
cues: Place elbows a little ahead of shoulders.
Hold a straight line. Stop when that line breaks.

rows.name: Pseudo-planche Push-up
cues: Hands near hips with a small forward lean.
Keep the lean steady through each clean rep.

rows.name: Scapular Pull
cues: Hang with straight arms.
Pull shoulders down a little, then relax.

rows.name: Shrimp Squat
cues: Stand on one foot with the other knee bent behind.
Lower only as far as you can control.

rows.name: Star Side Plank
cues: Stack shoulders and hips.
Raise the top leg only while steady.

rows.name: Support Hold
cues: Press down on stable bars.
Keep shoulders away from ears.

rows.name: Vertical Row
cues: Hold a secure anchor and lean back a little.
Pull chest toward hands without shrugging.

rows.name: Wall Push-up
cues: Hands on the wall at chest height.
Keep a straight line as you move in and out.

rows.title: Ask a market seller how they choose stock
